ControlCommandReceipt.description: One exact durable cancellation decision; not a native completion witness.

already_concluded.description: The study was already terminal at the original decision.

cancelled.description: Actual cancellation state at the original decision.

generation.description: Actual generation as exact decimal text; absent when the study was absent.

issuing_store.description: Original issuing database; never rebound after restore.

reason.description: Typed declared refusal identity, when refused.

ControlCommandStatus.description: Persisted command disposition, distinct from an unresolved transport outcome.

oneOf.description: The command was accepted, including an already concluded no-op.
The original decision refused the request without cancelling anything.

description: Missing means unobserved, never proof that an earlier request cannot still commit.

receipt.description: Original immutable decision if observed under this actor and issuing store.
